description: Primary plug-in surfaces for SAB artifacts and registry patterns inside Aaroneous.

surfaces.name: agent_orchestration
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB changes scheduling, delegation, supervision, or swarm coordination. This is the control plane that decides which specialist runs next and how results are aggregated.

surfaces.name: network_and_tooling
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB performs external IO: HTTP, websocket, RPC, email, browser automation, chat integration, or remote tool invocation. These SABs expand what Aaroneous can reach, not how it thinks.

surfaces.name: plugin_runtime_and_registry
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB loads, compiles, watches, or dispatches other plugins. This is the install-and-discover surface for dynamic capabilities and repo-backed assets.

surfaces.name: ui_embodiment_and_control
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB renders screens, handles input, drives AR/VR, or controls a physical or desktop device. These are the embodiment surfaces where intents become visible actions.

surfaces.name: data_graph_storage
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB parses, indexes, stores, queries, or transforms structured data. This is the analytics and persistence surface where workflows become searchable and reproducible.

surfaces.name: ml_modeling
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB scores, embeds, infers, or selects models. This is where we plug in local inference, model selection, and numeric learning paths.

surfaces.name: distributed_trust_security
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB adds identity, signing, wallets, secrets, peers, or secure transport. This is the trust boundary for federation and external access.

surfaces.name: shared_state_blackboard
surfaces.reason: Use here when a SAB shares memory, publishes state, or coordinates via a common workspace. Blackboard-style plugins belong here because they influence how specialists see and update shared context.
